probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from the group consisting of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, frequency of mode usage, spatial resolution, and temporal resolution__.

2. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters comprise coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence.

3. (Original) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the coding information comprises at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution.

4. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein at least a portion of the sequence is encoded into a resultant bitstream, and the adapted mode mapping information is signaled in the resultant bitstream.

5. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element.

6. (Original) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the high level syntax element is comprised in at least one of a slice header, a sequence parameter set, a picture parameter set, a network abstraction layer unit header, and a supplemental enhancement information message.

7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is __determined and__ updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on actual parameters of the subsequently encoded pictures__.

8. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the determination occurs prior to encoding the picture__.
